flags.why: This word for a fork is mainly Central and Southern usage ([regional vocabulary table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnamese_language#Vocabulary)).
The common meaning describing fast, strong water flow is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-xi%E1%BA%BFt)).
flags.fix: verb | to flow fast and strongly (of water); ex: Nước sông chảy xiết. = The river water flows fast and strongly.

flags.why: Xiết here means 'able to', with inability supplied by không, so the gloss incorrectly builds the negative into the word ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-xi%E1%BA%BFt)).
flags.fix: to be able to; can (dialectal, usually following a verb under negation)

flags.why: Khiêng không xiết means they cannot carry it, rather than that they can barely carry it ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-xi%E1%BA%BFt)).
flags.fix: This stone is too heavy; even two people cannot carry it.

flags.why: This sense means rubbing or moving forcefully against a surface and does not require a tube or roller ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-xi%E1%BA%BFt)).
flags.fix: to rub or scrape forcefully against a surface

flags.why: The common colloquial meaning of being obstinate and disregarding reason is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/c%C3%B9n)).
flags.fix: adj [colloquial] | obstinate; impervious to reason; ex: Đừng cãi cùn nữa. = Stop arguing without regard for reason.

flags.why: Cùn meaning trousers is a regional form used in North Central Vietnam, including Nghệ An and Hà Tĩnh ([regional usage](https://nghengu.vn/tieng-nghe-cua-toi/hoc-tieng-nghe-an-ha-tinh-van-o-p-q-r-s-t-u-v-x-y-841.html)).
